{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
# Even if the current sample doesn't show commas, the documentation says it's exported with thousands separators
# So we must strip commas
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Check that the cleaning worked
print(f"First 5 cleaned revenue values: {df['revenue_clean'].head().tolist()}")

# Confirm no more 999999.99 rows
print(f"Number of rows with revenue_clean == 999999.99: {len(df[df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99])}")

# Confirm refunded orders are still present
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {len(df[df['status'] == 'refunded'])}")

# Also check that customer_age -1 is still there
print(f"Number of -1 values in customer_age: {len(df[df['customer_age'] == -1])}")"}
